description_en: You can invoke ListBriefSkillGroups to obtain the list of skill group summary information under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListBriefSkillGroups获取指定实例下的技能组概要信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-brief-skill-groups --instance-id ccc-test --search-pattern skillgroup --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --media-type CHAT --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBriefSkillGroups

parameters.description_en: Perform fuzzy matching based on the skill group name or display name. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty, which means no filtering is applied.
